scripts.db:mongo:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d mongodb
scripts.dev:api:mongo: cd apps/api && DB_TYPE=mongodb MONGODB_URL=${MONGODB_URL:-mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/?replicaSet=rs0} MONGO_DB_NAME=${MONGO_DB_NAME:-pxm_db} pnpm dev
scripts.dev:engine:mongo: cd apps/engine && DB_TYPE=mongodb MONGODB_URL=${MONGODB_URL:-mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/?replicaSet=rs0} MONGO_DB_NAME=${MONGO_DB_NAME:-pxm_db} cargo run
